offering_description.value: Diamond Hill manages actively invested equity and fixed-income portfolios for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors. Its investment teams use fundamental research to select securities for pooled funds and separately managed accounts.

primary_products.value: Equity mutual funds; fixed-income mutual funds; collective investment trusts

primary_services.value: Institutional portfolio management; separately managed accounts; investment subadvisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: Institutional asset owners, retirement plan sponsors, investment advisers and other asset managers; B2C: Individual investors who buy fund shares directly or through financial intermediaries
